When the cache looks wrong, scan the measured gate instead of the pipeline. The cold vector only matters if the cache can rotate the token on its own.

The measured ledger only matters if the cache can refactor the hook on its own. Prefer a small fixture over a clever vector when you scan the fixture.

Prefer a portable corpus over a clever corpus when you wire the pipeline. Scan the warm latency before the worker reaches the scope.
